## Intake
Validate the WF-001 command contract and preserve context.

## Routing
Only the selected command branch executes.

## Novel Creation Pipeline
WF-002 → WF-003 → WF-005

## Chapter Knowledge Pipeline
WF-004 → WF-005 → WF-006 → WF-007 → WF-008 → WF-009 → WF-010 → WF-011 → WF-012

## Error Handling
Every validation gate routes blocking results to the shared summary and marks remaining stages skipped.

## Output
Build one integration summary and telegram.reply contract.
